bosses.name: Revelosh
bosses.general: Trogg shaman: Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning.
bosses.tank: Pull him round a corner into melee.

bosses.name: Baelog
bosses.general: The Lost Dwarves: Baelog shoots, Eric "The Swift" runs fast and hits hard, Olaf blocks with his shield.
bosses.tank: Grab all three; Eric moves fast, keep him on you.
bosses.healer: Three on the tank at first: steady heals.
bosses.dps: Eric first, then Baelog, Olaf last.

bosses.name: Ironaya
bosses.general: Stone keeper: Arcing Smash cleaves, Knock Away throws the tank, War Stomp at half health.
bosses.tank: Face her away from everyone, back to a wall.
bosses.healer: Stay at range, heal through the knockbacks.
bosses.dps: Melee from behind; step out before the stomp.

bosses.name: Obsidian Sentinel
bosses.general: Breaks off Obsidian Shards as it takes damage.
bosses.healer: Several mobs on the tank as shards pile up.
bosses.dps: Area attacks on the shards, then the sentinel.

bosses.name: Ancient Stone Keeper
bosses.general: Sand storms wander the room and Trample hits the melee.
bosses.tank: Move it away from the sand storms.
bosses.healer: Dodge the storms, heal the trample.

bosses.name: Galgann Firehammer
bosses.general: Dark Iron caster: Fire Nova, Flame Lash and Amplify Flames.
bosses.healer: Heal the fire on the melee.
bosses.dps: Melee step out on Fire Nova; interrupt his casts.

bosses.name: Grimlok
bosses.general: Trogg chief: Lightning Bolt, Shrink and Bloodlust.

bosses.name: Archaedas
bosses.general: Wakes when the disc is used: Ground Tremor stuns, he awakens Earthen Guardians and later the Vault Warders.
bosses.tank: Grab the guardians as they wake and hold Archaedas.
bosses.healer: Heal through the tremors; several adds on the tank.
bosses.dps: Kill the guardians quickly, then focus Archaedas.
